unit.why: A genealogical list of R. Moshe of Zhydachiv's sons that frames a short narrative, sent in a letter, about the dead R. Yeshaya appearing to his brother R. Kapil, who later died in the same town.
unit.boundary_note: division ends with the heading of the next section (sayings of R. Moshe), which belongs to the following division

stories.start_quote: הרב ר׳ ישעי׳ נפטר ונטמן בעיר סגאטין
stories.end_quote: ונסתלק שמה ומונחים שמה גם יחד
stories.summary_en: After R. Yeshaya, son of R. Moshe, died and was buried in Snyatyn, he appeared to his brother R. Kapil while he was awake and asked him to come to him because he was lonely there; R. Kapil first went home to give his last instructions, later returned to Snyatyn, died there and was buried beside his brother.
